title: Workshop on CEH Skills
description: An interactive session focused on strengthening the key concepts of ethical hacking, cybersecurity, system vulnerabilities, and cyber threats.Through real-world examples and practical demonstrations, participants learned about vulnerability assessment, and defensive security practices.

title: Workshop on Generative AI
description: The Workshop on Generative AI introduced students to the fundamentals and real-world applications of modern AI technologies. With at least 96 participants, the session provided hands-on exposure through live demonstrations, including chatbot development using industry tools.
